summary: Family B18 (labelled spanning trees of finite simple graphs). The helpers `X167.x167_spanning_tree` and `X168.x168_spanning_tree` (`T \subset fg_edges G /\ is_tree [set: fg_labelled_sgraph T]`) now unfold to the new public `GTBase.spanning_trees.fg_spanning_tree T`, the same body over `GTBase.finite_graph` and upstream `is_tree`, by conversion. Contract: `T` is a set of valid edges of `G` (the subset guard is kept: the labelled-graph constructor retains every two-element member, including host nonedges, and ignores members that are not pairs; the subset guard rejects host nonedges) whose labelled graph on the WHOLE vertex carrier of `G`, isolated vertices included, is a tree (unique irredundant paths and connected). Conventions derived from upstream `is_tree`, never added as guards: the empty edge set spans `'K_0` (vacuously) and `'K_1`; the single edge spans `'K_2`; the triangle's full edge set, one edge of the triangle (a vertex is missed), two isolated vertices and any set containing a singleton are rejected. No nonempty guard, edge-count characterisation or validity repair is introduced.

API: `fg_spanning_tree`, `fg_spanning_treeb` with `fg_spanning_treeP`, the projections `fg_spanning_tree_sub`, `fg_spanning_tree_tree`, `fg_spanning_tree_forest`, `fg_spanning_tree_connected`, the introduction `fg_spanning_treeI`, the upstream edge-set form `fg_spanning_treeE` (through `fg_edgesE`), edge validity (`fg_edges_edge`, `fg_spanning_tree_valid`, `fg_spanning_tree_edge`), whole-carrier covering `fg_spanning_tree_cover` and host connectivity `fg_spanning_tree_connectedG`; groundings `fg_edges_Kn`, `fg_spanning_tree_K0`, `fg_spanning_tree_K1`, `fg_spanning_tree_K2`, `not_fg_spanning_tree_K3`, `not_fg_spanning_tree_K3_edge`, `not_fg_spanning_tree_two_isolated`, `not_fg_spanning_tree_singleton`.
